description: Slot indices of garments before and after Suit Enhancement Suite 0.5.0. Saves store a worn item's position as ParentSlotId (the index in its parent's slot list); the game moves it there on load without checking the slot type. Only uniforms move; suits and body armor keep every index.

garments.match: Thing whose C# type is Assets.Scripts.Objects.Clothing.Uniform (UniformOrangeJumpSuit, UniformMarine, UniformCommander, ...)
garments.vanillaSlotCountEvidence: LIVE save Vulcan2_4 (2026-09-27): UniformOrangeJumpSuit had its own slots at 4..7 under the old layout
garments.rule: V = vanillaSlotCount. old i < 4 -> V + i; old i >= 4 -> i - 4. New slots V+4 and V+5 (shared power) have no old counterpart.

garments.match: SuitBase (space suits, Hardsuit, Icarus, HARM suit, EVA suit) and other clothing whose prefab name contains Suit, Icarus or Armor, except uniforms and body armor
garments.layout: vanilla 0..N-1, Water N, Food N+1 (Hardsuit: N = 8, Water 8, Food 9)

garments.match: Thing whose C# type is BodyArmor (Marine Vest)
garments.layout: vanilla 0..N-1, storage 1..8 at N..N+7, Water N+8, Food N+9
